summary: Sysco Corp and numerous subsidiary guarantor co-registrants filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) on September 18, 2026, covering a takedown from an existing shelf registration statement (SEC File No. 333-298926). The excerpt does not disclose any special-situation transaction, price per share, premium, stake, or strategic event; it is a routine debt or equity securities offering registration document. As an ordinary shelf takedown, it falls outside special-situations categories, and no deal terms or risk-arb angle are presented in the available text.
